description: One club, as the list at clubs.json holds it. A club is text: it has no crest and no logo.

name.description: The resource name, clubs/{club}. The slug is stable and never reused.

displayName.description: The club's name as the card shows it, as plain text with no markup.

countryCode.description: The FIFA three-letter code of the club's association, such as ENG. Absent when it is not known.

updateTime.description: When this club's content last changed, as an RFC 3339 moment in UTC.
